messages:
aya: Heads-up — I'm drafting a runbook for capability tokens + scoped delegation. High-level goal: keep RBAC for humans, capabilities for machines, low friction for users.
devin: 👍 Can we support an exchange endpoint so existing project keys can mint short-lived capability tokens without immediate code changes?
aya: Yes — plan `/v1/auth/exchange` that accepts a project_key and requested capabilities. Exchange requires audit metadata and rate limits.
harper: For CI/cron jobs that can't rotate often, allow a long-lived `ci:worker` token with enforced rotation (90d) and console-readable audit trail. Prefer delegated short-lived tokens (5–15m) for request-time operations.
devin: Gateway enforcement should verify JWS (kid -> key lookup), validate `cap` claim array, `exp`, and `aud`. If verification fails (e.g., on-prem customers), fall back to introspection endpoint.
security-bot: Security note: require `aud` binding and origin checks for webhooks. For highly sensitive operations, support single-use tokens (jti + single_use flag) and server-side mark-as-used.
aya: Telemetry: emit `auth.credential_type` with labels {endpoint, credential_type}. Build dashboard and alert if >2% of traffic to sensitive endpoints uses project_key after warning window.
devin: Migration phases: 1) implement mint + SDK helpers; 2) opt-in endpoints accept both token types + collect telemetry; 3) return warn header when project_key used; 4) enforce capability tokens only. Include dry-run mode and emergency toggle for SRE.
harper: Back-compat UX: console "exchange key → capability" flow and CLI: `redwood auth mint --from-key K_abc --caps models:read --ttl 3600`.
aya: Rate-limits: keep quotas tied to project_id, not token_id, to avoid accidental throttling when callers split usage across many tokens.
security-bot: Threat model checklist: stolen capability token → mitigate with short TTL, aud/origin checks, revocation list; issuance CSRF mitigations for console flows.
ops-bot: Canary deployed: auth-exchange v0.1 -> staging at 2024-06-20T08:00:00Z :rocket:
aya: I'll file a short RFC with API shapes, gateway validation snippet, example curl commands, and the SRE runbook by EOD Wednesday. Ping me for review.
